scripts.config: cp config.development.json client/config.json && cp config.development.json server/config.json
scripts.release:config: cp config.prod.json client/config.json && cp config.prod.json server/config.json
scripts.start-client: npm run build --prefix client && npm run start --prefix client
scripts.start-server: concurrently --names build,start "npm run build-watch --prefix server" "npm run start-watch --prefix server"
scripts.install: concurrently --names server,client "npm install --prefix server" "npm install --prefix client"
